pronunciation_overrides.Tensorblue: tˈɛnsəɹblˌu (not in the misaki lexicon; accepted CTA)

lines.text: You deleted this photo on your phone. Why is it still on your laptop?
Some deletes only remove this device's copy. The cloud keeps its own.
A synced delete is different: every device removes its copy.
Even then, it waits in the trash, often for thirty days.
And older backups can keep a copy until they're removed.
For permanent removal: sync the delete, empty the trash, check your backups.
